hero.title: Once a week, Felix checks in.
hero.subtitle: Felix is an AI phone assistant. He calls you once a week. He asks how you are and whether everything with your care is going as agreed. He passes on what your care team should know. All you need is your phone.

lines.text: Hello, this is Felix. Am I speaking to Mrs Müller?
I’m calling from Pflegeunion. Is now a good time for a short chat?
Did everything with your care go as agreed this week?
In the mornings they often come later than arranged.

hero.aiNote: Felix is an AI and never pretends to be human.

problem.title: Between two care appointments, some things go unsaid.
problem.text: Whether after a care visit or after a day at day care, small things often go unsaid. A question, a worry, an appointment that did not go as agreed.
problem.solutionTitle: Felix checks in once a week.
problem.solutionText: Felix calls and listens. He passes on what your care team should know. The team decides what happens next.

voice.title: Friendly, honest and with clear limits.
voice.intro: Felix speaks German. He is not human, and he will tell you so if you ask. Three examples:

lines.text: Are you actually a real person?
No. I’m an AI assistant for Pflegeunion, in other words a computer program.
Not so good. I’m worried about my grandson.
I’m sorry to hear that. Would you like to talk about it, or would you rather talk about something else?
Did everything with your care go as agreed this week?
Basically, yes. But in the mornings they often come late.

meta.title: How it works
meta.description: How Felix works: your carer introduces Felix, you decide, and Felix calls once a week.

hero.title: How Felix works
hero.text: All you need is a phone. Your carer will explain everything else to you.

start.title: Getting started
steps: Your carer introduces Felix to you in person.
Before Felix calls you for the first time, you get all the documents: information about Felix and about privacy, and the consent form.
You decide whether you want Felix. You can also say no. This does not change your care.

call.title: The call
call.text: First, Felix checks that he is speaking to the right person and asks whether now is a good time. Then he asks how you are and how your care is going. He can pick up where your last conversation left off. He does not talk about topics you do not want to talk about.

frequency.title: How often?
frequency.text: Once a week. If you do not answer, Felix will try again 24 hours later.

callYourself.title: Calling Felix yourself
callYourself.text: You can call Felix on the same number he calls from. For example, if you have missed a call.

after.title: After the call
after.text: Felix passes on what your care team should know. The team decides what happens next. Felix himself cannot promise you anything.

items.title: Not an emergency service
items.text: Felix cannot call anyone for you. In an emergency, call 112 straight away or press your emergency call button. If you mention an emergency, Felix will tell you to call 112.

items.title: No advice
items.text: Felix does not give advice on health, medication, nutrition, money, legal matters or benefits from the long-term care insurance fund. He tells you who to contact, for example your doctor or your care service’s office.

items.title: No assessment of symptoms
items.text: Felix also does not give instructions on first aid or medication.

items.title: Not a replacement
items.text: Felix does not replace your care or your contact with family and friends.

items.title: No selling
items.text: Felix does not offer you anything and makes no decisions about your care.

stop.title: Stopping Felix
stop.text: Tell Felix during a call, or tell your carer or the office. Then you will not get any more calls. This does not change your care.

meta.title: Frequently asked questions
meta.description: Answers to common questions about Felix, the AI phone assistant for clients of Pflegeunion.

hero.title: Questions and answers
hero.text: Answers to common questions about Felix.

forWhom.a: For clients of Pflegeunion, in home care and in day care.

human.a: No. Felix is an AI phone assistant, in other words a computer program that can speak and listen. Your carer will explain this to you before you start, and Felix will tell you whenever you ask.

howToGet.a: Speak to your carer. They will explain Felix to you. Before Felix calls you for the first time, you get all the documents.

number.q: Which number does Felix call from?
number.a: Felix always calls from the same number: {number}. It is best to save the number as “Felix”.

callYourself.q: Can I also call Felix myself?
callYourself.a: Yes, on the same number. If you need something from your care service, please continue to call the office.

missed.q: What happens if I don’t answer?
missed.a: Felix will try again 24 hours later. If that is not a good time either, just tell him when to call.

emergency.a: Always call 112 straight away or press your emergency call button. Felix is not an emergency service and cannot call anyone for you. If you mention an emergency, Felix will tell you to call 112.

recording.a: There is no audio recording, and no human listens in live. What you say is saved as text. You will find all the details in your privacy information.

careTeam.q: What does my care team find out?
careTeam.a: Not your whole conversation. Felix passes on what your care team should know. The team decides what happens next.

advice.q: Does Felix give me advice on health or medication?
advice.a: No. Felix tells you who to contact, for example your doctor or your care service’s office.

replace.a: No. Your care stays exactly as it is. Felix is an extra check-in.

sales.q: Does Felix want to sell me something?
sales.a: No. Felix only asks how you are and how your care is going.

noComputer.q: I don’t want to talk to a computer.
noComputer.a: That is perfectly fine. It is your decision.

hearing.q: I don’t hear well, or I don’t like talking on the phone.
hearing.a: Then Felix may not be right for you, and that is not a problem. Feel free to speak to your carer.

stop.a: Just tell Felix during a call. You can also tell your carer or the office. This does not change your care.

languages.q: Does Felix speak other languages too?

stillQuestions.title: Didn’t find your question?
stillQuestions.text: Write to us using the contact form. For questions about your care, please contact your care service’s office as usual.

motivation.title: Why Felix exists
paragraphs: Many older people live alone. Carers have little time, and it is often quiet between appointments. At the same time, the care team only finds out about some things late. Who really likes to complain to the friendly carer standing right in front of them?
That is why Felix exists: one call a week that checks in, listens and passes on what the care team should know.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy applies to this website. Here we explain which data is processed when you visit the website and when you send an enquiry using the contact form, and what rights you have.

controller.heading: 1. Who is responsible?
controller.text: The party responsible for processing your data on this website is:

sections.heading: 2. Visiting this website and hosting (Vercel)
paragraphs: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA. When you visit the website, technical data sent by your browser is processed automatically: IP address, date and time, the page you opened, browser type and operating system. This data is needed to deliver the website securely and reliably.

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure operation). A data processing agreement is in place with Vercel. Vercel is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. In addition, the EU standard contractual clauses apply.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies
paragraphs: This website does not set any cookies for advertising or analytics purposes. That is why you do not see a cookie banner.

sections.heading: 4. The Felix service
paragraphs: If you use Felix, we process personal data for this purpose, including information about your health. Our separate privacy information explains which data this is, what we use it for and on what legal basis, who receives it, how long we store it and what rights you have. You will receive it together with the consent form before Felix calls you for the first time.

sections.heading: 5. Contact form and email
paragraphs: If you write to us using the contact form or by email, we process your details (name, email address, phone number if provided, and your message) to answer your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR if it relates to a contract, otherwise Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

sections.heading: 6. Sending emails (Resend)
paragraphs: We use the Resend service (Resend, Inc., 2261 Market Street #5039, San Francisco, CA 94114, USA) to forward enquiries from the contact form. This involves processing the details you entered in the form. A data processing agreement is in place with Resend. The transfer to the USA is safeguarded by EU standard contractual clauses. The legal basis is the same as for the contact form.

sections.heading: 7. How long we store data
paragraphs: We only store your data for as long as is necessary for the purpose in question. After that, we delete it, unless we are required by law to keep it.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the following rights at any time:
list: Information about your stored data (Art. 15 GDPR)
Withdrawal of consent with effect for the future (Art. 7(3) GDPR)
after: You can also complain to a data protection supervisory authority. The authority responsible for us is: Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit Nordrhein-Westfalen, Kavalleriestraße 2-4, 40213 Düsseldorf.

sections.heading: 9. Data security
paragraphs: This website uses an encrypted connection (TLS). You can see this from the padlock symbol in your browser. We protect your data with technical and organisational measures.

sections.heading: 10. Changes
paragraphs: We update this privacy policy when our service or the legal situation changes. The version currently on this page applies.
